requirements.description: Compustat annual price, dividend and share inputs used to form the PEG portfolios and scale earnings forecasts.

required_coverage.population: U.S. firms with December fiscal year-end in the annual PEG portfolio sample

routes.coverage_notes: A bounded probe verifies access and columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this resource and required period/population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The local probe verifies fields only. No coordinator coverage confirmation establishes 1981–1999 coverage for December fiscal-year firms; source paper uses the 1999 Compustat vintage.

requirements.description: I/B/E/S median annual EPS forecasts and the longer-horizon growth forecast used to derive eps2.

requirements.description: Historical matching of I/B/E/S summary forecasts to Compustat firms for portfolio construction.

required_coverage.frequency: annual firm forecasts and fiscal-year records
required_coverage.population: Same U.S. December year-end firms in IBES.STATSUM_EPSUS and COMP.FUNDA
required_coverage.detail: CUSIP is present in both products, but the paper’s historical match procedure, identifier validity and conflict resolution are not specified.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No exact historical I/B/E/S-to-Compustat crosswalk or paper matching rule is verified. CUSIP equality alone is not a validated historical link.

requirements.description: Formation of 1,499 annual PEG-sorted portfolios, including the December year-end eligibility rule, negative EPS1 exclusion and upper-tail EPS1/P0 exclusion.

required_coverage.population: Annual portfolio formation from the specified U.S. December fiscal-year firms
required_coverage.detail: The paper reports 20 observations per regression fit, while another passage says 22 firms per portfolio; the count and cutoff for deleting the highest EPS1/P0 observations are not given.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The unexplained 20-versus-22 portfolio size and unreported upper-tail cutoff prevent exact reconstruction of the frozen sample.

variable_coverage.construction: Forecast of cum-dividend accounting earnings two periods ahead, divided by firm j’s price per share at time 0. Equation (5) implies ceps_{j,2}=eps_{j,2}+r*dps_{j,1}, and the empirical procedure uses the I/B/E/S forecast of eps2 and assumes dps1=dps0. Adjacent prose on page 7 instead states ceps2=eps1+r*dps1; the paper therefore contains a genuine EPS1/EPS2 discrepancy. The exact transformation from the I/B/E/S three-year growth forecast to eps2 is not specified.
